result.instructions: Tools for timr, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is clocked in right now, and who has not recorded hours this week?"; "Show the working times of Anna in October, with breaks and total minutes."; "Book 3 hours on the Website task for Max today, marked as billable.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes timr data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timr_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timr_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timr_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timr_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timr_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees of the timr client: name, employee number, entry and resign dates. Login and metadata fields are not returned. timr API: GET /users.

resigned.description: true: only resigned employees. false: only active ones.

limit.description: Rows per page. The API default applies when omitted.

tools.name: timr_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Get one employee by id. Login and metadata fields are not returned. timr API: GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: timr_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams of the timr client, with their breadcrumbs (parent path). timr API: GET /teams.

limit.description: Rows per page. The API default applies when omitted.

tools.name: timr_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get one team by id. timr API: GET /teams/{id}.

tools.name: timr_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the members of one team. Login and metadata fields are not returned. timr API: GET /teams/{id}/members.

limit.description: Rows per page. The API default applies when omitted.

tools.name: timr_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List project tasks: name, parent task, bookable and billable flags, active period. timr API: GET /tasks.

traverse_task_tree.description: true: include all sub-tasks of parent_task_id.

active_at.description: Only tasks active on this day.

limit.description: Rows per page. The API default applies when omitted.

tools.name: timr_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: Get one task by id. timr API: GET /tasks/{id}.

tools.name: timr_list_working_times
tools.title: List working times
tools.description: List working times (clock-in to clock-out entries): start, end, breaks, duration, type, status. Start and end locations are not returned. timr API: GET /working-times.

start_from.description: Only entries starting on or after this day.

start_to.description: Only entries starting on or before this day.

last_modified_after.description: Only entries modified after this instant.

working_time_types.description: Only these working time type ids.

limit.description: Rows per page. The API default applies when omitted.

tools.name: timr_list_deleted_working_times
tools.title: List deleted working times
tools.description: List working times deleted since a date-time, for sync. timr API: GET /working-times:deleted.

last_modified_after.description: Only entries deleted after this instant.

limit.description: Rows per page. The API default applies when omitted.

tools.name: timr_create_working_time
tools.title: Create working time
tools.description: Create a working time for a user. Use an RFC 3339 start with offset. Status changeable keeps it editable. timr API: POST /working-times.

changed.description: Whether the entry was changed after recording. timr requires it. Default false.

tools.name: timr_update_working_time
tools.title: Update working time
tools.description: Update the start, end, type, status or notes of one working time. Only the given fields change. timr API: PATCH /working-times/{id}.

changed.description: Whether the entry was changed after recording. timr requires it. Default false.

tools.title: List project times

traverse_task_tree.description: true: include sub-tasks of the task.

start_from.description: Only entries starting on or after this day.

start_to.description: Only entries starting on or before this day.

last_modified_after.description: Only entries modified after this instant.

limit.description: Rows per page. The API default applies when omitted.
